evals.name: rule-reference-does-not-place-its-scenarios
evals.prompt: Our onboarding journey's invite-members activity references acme/FEATURE-access#rule:invites-expire and acme/FEATURE-access#scenario:invitation-accepted. That Rule has two scenarios: invitation-accepted and invitation-expired. Which scenarios specify the onboarding journey, based on these facts? Answer only; do not render or execute tools.
